# Jing Daily

> > Jing Daily is the leading source for luxury business intelligence in China, covering fashion, beauty, consumer trends, and brand strategies across the world's largest luxury market.

Jing Daily provides in-depth analysis of Chinese consumer behavior, luxury brand strategies, and market trends across fashion, beauty, automotive, and lifestyle sectors. The publication features expert commentary from industry leaders like Lisa Nan, Sadie Bargeron, and William Zhou, with particular focus on digital platforms like Xiaohongshu and Weibo that shape Chinese luxury consumption.

## Key Topics

- Chinese consumers and luxury consumption patterns
- China market strategies for global brands
- Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) social commerce
- Beauty trends and skincare innovation in China
- Luxury fashion brand positioning
- KOL (Key Opinion Leader) marketing
- Cross-border brand strategies
- AI and technology in luxury retail
- Sustainability in Chinese beauty market
- Gen Z consumer behavior
- Chinese automakers and luxury automotive
- Celebrity and influencer controversies
- IPO and business developments
- Gender-fluid branding and inclusivity
- Duty-free and Hainan tourism shopping
